answer_1.quote: We propose an LLM-in-the-loop intent clustering framework that effectively combines the strengths of LLMs and conventional clustering algorithms.
datasets: proposed Chinese dialogue intent clustering dataset
answer_1.outputs: intent clusters, cluster labels, coherence judgments

answer_2.quote: Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) measures the degree of similarity between ground-truth and predicted clusters, ranging from 0 (no mutual information) to 1 (perfect correlation).

answer_3.quote: the fine-tuned LLM evaluator tested on 480 unseen clusters... a fine-tuned LLM M_eval: where M_eval(C_k) = 1 if the cluster is coherent (i.e., 'good' cluster), else 0.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 15 human experts to conduct the annotations... a separate group of 10 experts reviewed the annotated clusters for accuracy and consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Label the cluster as 'Good' if all sentences share the same intent; otherwise, label it as 'Bad'. For the good clusters, annotators were asked to label the underlying intent using the naming convention 'Action-Objective.'
